# OpenSC headers

Unmodified public headers from OpenSC tag `0.27.1`:
https://github.com/OpenSC/OpenSC/tree/0.27.1/src

Copyright and license notices remain in each file. LGPL 2.1 or later; see
COPYING. These headers describe the dynamically loaded system OpenSC runtime.
No OpenSC implementation or vendor binary is embedded in TokenSigner. Runtime
version is checked before using its structures; other versions fail explicitly.
